warnings: Axes: x = 1-2-3 at 4.00 + 4.00 (8.00); y = A-B-C-D-E at 4.00 + 2.00 + 4.00 + 2.50 (12.50). Origin A1. The same main chains print on S-01..S-05 and A-10. Vector CAD PDF with no text layer - every value read off the rendered page.

x dummies in the 1-2 gap follow position order (section 4): 1'' 0.40 (S-02 shaft-corner beam), 1''' 1.15 (S-09 ST-1 chain), 1'''' 1.80 (S-02 / S-09), 1''''' 2.50 (S-01..S-04), 1'''''' 3.00 (scaled, S-05 wing eave); 1' -1.00 is the roof eave before the origin and shares the sequence.

C' (8.00) and x 1'''''' (3.00) are the only lines not read off a printed dimension: on S-05 the hip from C2 and the valley (ตะเข้ราง) to D2 meet on the Truss T4 line at 2.00 from C and 2.00 from D (both 45 deg, scaled against the C-D grid) - kept as a dummy with confidence 0.7 and flag scaled_from_grid so the hip/valley ends have a position. The valley continues past D2 to the eave corner of the left wing near x 3.00 / D'; that x position is printed nowhere, so it was first left without a line; it is now the scaled dummy x 1'''''' (3.00), because two members end there (the valley past D2 at D' and the wing hip from E2 at E'), both 45 deg from known grid points, and the T2 top chord on row E starts there - confidence 0.7, flag scaled_from_grid (beam-endpoint rule, section 4 span amendment).

S-06 truss elevations (T1, T2, T3, T4) print full panel chains but no grid markers under them, so per section 4 rule 4 they are floating chains: recorded with "edge" ends and no lines were created. Their totals agree with the plan (T1 8.00 = 1-3, T3 10.00 = A-D, T2 4.00 = 2-3, T4 6.50 = C-E) - the elements on the S-05 / S-06 files carry the positions.

z: ±0.00 = ระดับถนนภายใน (A-10, A-01 notes). Two different levels are both printed as ระดับหลังอกไก่ (+7.67 and +8.82); their ids carry the printed value to stay distinct. ระดับดินเดิม (S-07) prints no value; the footing depths below it stay on the footing elements.

Dimension sweep covers the structural sheets S-01..S-09 plus A-10 (building section, for levels). The other architectural / MEP sheets (A-03..A-09, A-11..A-13, E-01..E-02, SN-01..SN-03) were not dimension-swept in this op04 (pass2-only) run; A-12 (stair plan) repeats the 1.150 + 2.850 x chain recorded here from S-09. S-07 / S-08 print only member-internal dimensions (section sizes, cap sizes, slab thicknesses), which stay on their elements.
